cues.zh: 同时还有空间给骑行者，有空间给行人，有空间给汽车
cues.en: and still have space for cyclists, have space for pedestrians, and have space for cars

cues.zh: 我觉得这给了我们的孩子自由，让他们能自己去参加运动、去找朋友
cues.en: Gives our children the freedom to go to their sports to go to their friends all by their own I think

cues.zh: 在国际上，这相当罕见。从小就这样
cues.en: Internationally, that's quite exceptional. That's from a young age

cues.zh: 你可以想去哪就去哪，不需要父母的帮助
cues.en: on you can go about where you like without the help of your parents

cues.zh: 所以它确实有很多优势，尤其是在城市环境中
cues.en: So it really has a lot of advantages especially in urban circumstances

cues.zh: 这对居民意义重大，他们能够在自己的城市里生活、工作和娱乐
cues.en: And that means so much for the residents who are able to live work and play in their city

cues.zh: 而不必让出行、生计和幸福被汽车所限制
cues.en: without having their mobility and their livelihood and their happiness limited by cars
